front: What is ecommerce eks layout in one sentence?
back: Terraform + Helm module boundaries for the e-commerce platform on AWS EKS — extends Terraform setup with env accounts, namespaces, and per-service charts.

front: Explain the mental model of ecommerce eks layout (how the system thinks).
back: Terraform owns cloud resources (network, cluster, databases, broker, IAM). Helm owns workload manifests (Deployments, HPA, Rollouts, ConfigMaps). GitOps (Argo CD) syncs Helm releases from env branches or OCI chart versions.

front: Symptom: Pod AccessDenied Secrets — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: IRSA annotation vs Terraform role · Fix: Align SA name, namespace, trust policy

front: Symptom: Helm upgrade loop — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: CRD / Rollout conflict · Fix: Separate platform chart upgrade window

front: Symptom: RDS connection storm — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Too many pods, no connection pooling · Fix: PgBouncer sidecar or RDS Proxy in Terraform module

front: Symptom: Wrong cluster deploy — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Argo CD destination · Fix: destination.server + namespace guardrails

front: Symptom: State lock — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Terraform workflow · Fix: terraform force-unlock after confirming no run

front: Gotcha with ecommerce eks layout: what silently fails?
back: One mega Terraform root — blast radius; split state: network, eks, data per env.

front: When should you NOT use ecommerce eks layout?
back: Local/docker-compose only — use Terraform docker + compose for dev; skip EKS module until integration env needed. ECS instead of EKS — replace modules/eks with ECS/Fargate module; Helm section becomes task definitions.
